title: Trump’s Tough Week, Ansarallah Advances Again, Iran Tightens Control on Strait Of Hormuz
author: Sarmad Jawad
content:
In this week's episode of The War Brief, we discuss U.S. President Donald
Trump considering new strikes on Iran and how that highlights the numerous
setbacks he is facing in the region, from Iran increasing imposing its will on
the Strait of Hormuz, to the Ansarallah (Houthis) in Yemens consolidating
their control on Bab al-Mandab, and the emergency withdrawal of American B1B
bombers from the UK.

We are then joined by Drop Site contributor [Bonzer
Barry](https://x.com/bonzerbarry) to break down the latest in military
developments in Yemen.

Later on I am joined by [Dr. Shahryar Pasandideh](https://x.com/shahpas), who
argues that the withdrawal of the bombers from the UK is more consequential
than it appears. And with the bombers now stationed in the continental United
States, their capacity to bomb Iran will be reduced.
